title: Integral geometric preservation on the fixed-size constant-model hull
statement: Fix prime ell and a finite extension E of Q_ell embedded in its fixed algebraic closure, with its induced integral condensed coefficient Lambda = padicIntegersRingObj ell E. Over a field k of prime characteristic different from ell, let g:Z -> Y be proper between separated finite-type k-schemes. On the ordinary u+1-indexed localizing hulls of bounded finite-constant-model constructible complexes, assume h records preservation by ambient Rg_*, and let G be a right adjoint to exactly that lifted functor. For each bounded finite-constant-model constructible K on Y, every H^n(G(K)) has finite constant local models on a finite stratification. This statement concerns only integral coefficients.

proof.text: For a finite intermediate field, use localizingClosure_ctf_equals_bc to identify the finite-Tor generators with bounded constant-model constructible objects. Reuse the proved hull_eq comparison, giving equality of the u+1 hull with IntegralCompactSupport.localizing. The identity compactification is quasi-compact on its open part and its actual derived compact-support functor is ambient Rg_*, by the proved properIdentityPushforwardIso.

Transfer preservation and the supplied adjunction through the full inclusions using Adjunction.restrictFullyFaithful. Apply integralRestrictionGlue to that precise adjunction; its hG conclusion proves bounded constructibility. Taking its degree n cohomology proves integral_image_cohomology for the image-field case.

For the arbitrary embedded field E, take the fieldRange of its specified algebra embedding. equivFieldRange restricts to a ring equivalence of valuation rings: their defining embedded norms agree definitionally. The restricted equivalence is isometric. Postcomposition on continuous maps constructs a natural condensed ring isomorphism, with its actual specified multiplication.

The proved scalar-comap helpers transport finite scalar presentations and constant local models. On derived categories, comap_roundtrip constructs the coefficient equivalence. maps_localizingClosure transports the fixed-size hull, and its inverse plus repleteness gives an equivalence of hulls. derivedComapLowerStarIso identifies the actual ambient pushforwards after coefficient comap; restriction of the supplied adjunction yields the image-field adjunction. Apply integral_image_cohomology to the inverse-comapped K. The hull equivalence counits and the homology-comap isomorphism transport its constructibility back to the original G(K), including torsion and all cohomological degrees.

proof_origin.place: Completed C8 Lean proof: integralRestrictionGlue on the proper identity compactification, explicit valuation-ring image normalization, coefficient-derived hull equivalence, and counit/homology transport
